- [ASSISTANT_SAID] TikTok has gained traction among younger audiences, with companies creating humorous and engaging content for Gen Z.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, social media platforms significantly shape modern marketing strategies through paid advertising, influencers, and creative content.
